commands_used: answer 1. I work for the Toh-Reel-Ka, the order of the Xeech-Leel, as a Voh-Vastei. Hist trees are sickening and the Unbound drain sap, probably to make a draught to kill the Root guardian. The order wants the Eye of Argonia, which could heal the trees, before them. 2. Find the dealer selling an Eye of Argonia in Gideon market; the marker points at Ovinius Calo. 3. Talk to Ovinius Calo and pay or persuade him; examine the Eye of Argonia (Glass) that is here. 4. Not sure what "Glass" means for the Eye - it may be a fake. I can find out by talking to Calo and inspecting it.

answer 1. The Eye on sale is just glass. The smugglers who sold it keep the real old silver setting at Gideon South Watch. A relic-hunter called the Collector is also asking after the Eye. 2. Go to Gideon South Watch, SE of the quay, and take the setting from the locked chest in the inner room. 3. Fight the smugglers, sneak past, pick the chest lock, or take the key from the smuggler boss. 4. I do not know who the Collector is or what the setting leads to; I could find out by investigating further.
use Door to South Watch Inner Room

answer 1. I got the silver setting without a fight. The Collector, Ennodius Vanin, an Imperial relic-hunter, had opened the chest first and left a note: a ship name is scratched inside the band. 2. Bring the setting to Nesh-Deeka in Helstrom by rootworm from Gideon Hist garden. 3. Go straight to Nesh-Deeka, or first read the Collector note and inspect the band. 4. I do not know which ship the name is, or what the Collector wants; Nesh-Deeka may know.

answer 1. The Eye on sale was glass; the real trail is the Pale Harvest, a Company freighter sunk in Hatandros Bight with a Gideon dealer stock aboard. Nesh-Deeka paid me 100 gold and returned the setting. The Unbound were also asking after the glass Eye a month ago. 2. Nothing is assigned yet; presumably the wreck in Hatandros Bight (east coast south of Thorn) is next. 3. Ask Nesh-Deeka more, or head to the Bight. 4. I do not know how Nesh-Deeka knows what the Unbound did ("we listen"), or what is in the wreck.

answer I am a Voh-Vastei of the Toh-Reel-Ka, hunting the Eye of Argonia, which could heal the sick Hist trees. The Gideon Eye was glass (paid Ovinius Calo 20 gold). I picked the smugglers chest at Gideon South Watch without a fight and took the Old Silver Setting plus the Collector note (Ennodius Vanin, Imperial relic-hunter, has chased the Eye for 20 years). The setting has the ship name Pale Harvest scratched inside: a Company freighter sunk in Hatandros Bight, east coast south of Thorn, with a Gideon dealer stock aboard. Nesh-Deeka in Helstrom paid me 100 gold and returned the setting. Unbound were asking after the glass Eye in Gideon a month ago; Nesh-Deeka says only "we listen". I carry the setting, the note, and the gold. Next: the wreck in Hatandros Bight, and watch for the Unbound and the Collector.
